programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E01 - Russia - Comrades And Capitals
programme.desc: Anything is possible in Russia. Scott and Justin meet up with their friend Bogdan and visit the last man living in the radioactive zone in Chernobyl. They visit St. Petersburg for some homemade vodka and to celebrate Bogdan’s birthday, before hopping on an overnight train to Moscow. The adventures in Moscow are diverse: An awkward visit to a Russian bath, a wild night out in an exhilarating dance club and a chance to drive a cold-war military tank. Next, they fly to Siberia and meet a vodka-slamming shaman, who puts them all to shame on the dance floor.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E02 - Russia - The Bull Of Winter
programme.desc: The guys head northeast into Siberia to reach the coldest inhabited place on earth: the Pole of Cold. Along the way, the word of Scott and Justin’s journey travels and they become local news celebrities. They visit a permanent circus, take part in the Festival of Cold, answer questions at local press conferences and end up judging a quirky beauty contest in Yakutsk. Riding reindeer for the rest of the trek, they camp in the snow before hitting the Pole of Cold.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Travelling to Sri Lanka at the tail end of the 25-year civil war, the guys expect to visit a war-torn country, yet discover a different land. From exploring the wonders of Sigiriya, an ancient rock fortress and palace ruin, to visiting Sri Lanka’s indigenous inhabitants, the Veddas tribe, and joining the pilgrimage up Adam’s Peak, the guys experience a beautiful and culturally rich country. They get to Sri Lanka’s capital city, Colombo, just in time to see the Navam Perahera – a spectacular parade made up of thousands of dancers and acrobats, and over a hundred decorated elephants.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Scott and Justin catch up with their high school friend Fran, who is travelling to Vietnam to explore his motherland and family history for the first time. They travel south to north, through the commotion of Ho Chi Minh City and the Mekong River floating markets, and experiencing haunting remnants of the Vietnam war and visiting magical and mysterious temples and caves along the way. Further north, surrounded by the beauty of Halong Bay, the guys realize that spending time with Fran’s family, and seeing the country through his eyes, has given them a fresh perspective on travel.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E05 - Papua New Guinea - Fire And Water
programme.desc: One of the most fascinating places on earth, and one of the most dangerous, Papua New Guinea is a rough and mostly unexplored country. The guys meet up with their friend Nick on the island of East New Britain, where they visit the lava-buried city of Rabaul, and climb up, and into, an active volcano. Next they explore the island and local dive sites for abandoned World War II relics. Making their way through some thick jungle, they spend a night in a remote family village on their way to a spectacular fire-dancing tribe.

programme.title: Alan Cummings: Paradise Homes
programme.sub-title: Alan Cummings Paradise Homes S01 E03 Highland Hideaways and Caves
programme.desc: On a journey back to his rugged roots of the Scottish Highlands, Alan experiences an extraordinary hidden getaway living in harmony with ancient land, complete with 360 views and golden eagles circling the property. In Sicily, Alan tours an eccentric family home built above a cave, filled with innovative and intricate space-saving details, including a one-of-a-kind bedroom climbing wall!

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: The guys’ adventure begins by zip lining across jungle canopy, rappelling down waterfalls and bungee jumping off a city bridge. They dive with sharks off the Galapagos Islands, and realize the human impact on animals there. On the mainland, they stumble upon the Intiraymi festival, where celebrations are contrasted by near-riots between conflicting tribes. Next, they venture into the Amazon to find the Hourani tribe, and arrive the day of the Chief’s father’s funeral. Attending the ceremony, they learn how the tribes are fighting to keep their traditions alive and protect their land.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E08 - Ethiopia - Saints And Snakes
programme.desc: Scott and Justin explore the spiritual side of Ethiopia. In Lalibella, they visit ancient churches carved entirely out of stone, and Justin tries teaching a class of school children some new words. They visit the castles in Gondor and the Church of Saint Mary of Zion, which claims to house the lost Ark of the Covenant. At the Debra Damos monastery, accessible only by climbing a rope up a sheer cliff, they share some difficult but hilarious conversation with a well-spirited monk, who has some poignant things to say about brotherhood and human origins.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E09 - Ethiopia - Dances With Bulls
programme.desc: Scott and Justin meet up with Robel, who takes the guys to visit his sisters in his village of Harar. They visit the bustling chat market, and learn how to prepare the traditional stimulant. That night, Robel takes them to feed some wild hyenas by hand. Leaving Harar, they take a long drive to visit the Hammer Tribe. Here they witness a rare ceremony in which the women of the village offer themselves to be whipped, and one soon-to-be married man has to run, stark naked over a dozen bulls, to prove his worth as a husband.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Rwanda is a country emerging from its darkest years of poaching and the 1994 genocide. Scott and Justin travel with locals to learn more about how Rwanda is managing today. They explore the recovery of the animal population – from swimming cows on Napoleon Island to trekking into the wild to visit isolated groups of mountain gorillas. This experience is contrasted with a visit to the church of Ntarama to talk to a genocide survivor, and a court tribunal of several accused men. The guys hear stories of forgiveness from the people, and learn of their hope for their country.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: The guys arrive in the arctic destination at the beginning of winter. With only six hours of sunlight a day, they experience an entirely different type of adventure. Arriving by helicopter into the town of Ittoqqortoormiit, they take part in a seat hunt, and learn of the many ways people survive in this harsh arctic climate. With some basic training under their belt, the team heads off on a three-day trek to the abandoned ghost town of Cape Hope, where weather and extreme conditions pushes everyone’s utmost limits.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E12 - North Korea - The Other Side
programme.desc: Scott and Justin are prepared for perhaps their greatest adventure to date, providing them with a rare glimpse inside the borders of this isolated country. From Beijing, they depart to Pyongyang with an Englishman named Nick – an outsider with unprecedented access to the country. Meeting up with their local guides, Chae and Kim, the team visits many historical and political sights, learning the local perspective on world events, and gaining a much greater understanding of the country. An evening cruise down the Taedong River begins to cement a solid friendship between the guys and their guides.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E13 - North Korea - The Musical
programme.desc: North Koreans are a fiercely proud and creative people. North Korea continues to completely defy all expectations, as Scott and Justin take part in a high school English class, are pulled into numerous musical performances, visit a water bottling factory, a farm and an old funfair. Their experiences are capped off by the largest and most impressive choreographed spectacle on earth – the Arirang Mass Games – where 100,000 people perform the ultimate homage to their country and ideologies. The guys are sad to leave their trusted guides and friends behind when they depart by train back to Beijing.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E14 - Indonesia - Ring Of Fire
programme.desc: The trip begins on the caldera of Mount Bromo - an active, yet serene volcano in the middle of the island of Java. With their local friend Oka, they continue to the slums of Jakarta, meeting with a young boy and his family, and participating in daily activities to learn of the many hardships facing the locals. Heading to the island paradise of Bali, they take part in an explosive, traditional bull race. Scott gets “dirty” while Oka loses his chariot altogether. The trip winds down when they meet a Balinesian Prince, and join his party as guests of honour.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E15 - Indonesia - A Home Away
programme.desc: For three years, Scott and Justin have travelled the globe, experiencing so many people’s homes, while getting further away from their own. In their friend Oka’s home island of Bali, the guys witness both spiritual and illegal aspects of Balinesian life - grand temples, noisy bird markets and betting on underground cricket fights. They then travel back in time to the island of Sumba, staying overnight with a tribe who live in close harmony with nature and their ancestors. While Justin ponders returning home, Scott realizes that after three years on the road, there are more similarities between people and cultures than differences.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: From the southern coast of Adelaide, all the way to Darwin, the guys take on another road trip - this time with their own purchased 4x4 to get them through the perilous, dusty outback. Fighting constant breakdowns, they reach the underground town of Coober Pedy, where they search for opal with the help of an explosives “expert”. The crew travel from Uluru, staying on a working ranch, before tackling the ultimate off-road adventure through searing sand to remote Boggy Hole. Pushing on through a sudden rainstorm in the north, to the last miles to Darwin, Scott, Justin, and Andre have now travelled to all seven continents. What’s next?

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S02 E02 - Friluftsliv Pt 2
programme.desc: We go sea to summit with a skiing experience. We trek to an unskiied peak then go diving in the frozen ocean. Then we learn about sauna culture and how activity should be fun not work

programme.desc: Anything is possible in Russia. Scott and Justin meet up with their friend Bogdan and visit the last man living in the radioactive zone in Chernobyl. They visit St. Petersburg for some homemade vodka and to celebrate Bogdan’s birthday, before hopping on an overnight train to Moscow. The adventures in Moscow are diverse: An awkward visit to a Russian bath, a wild night out in an exhilarating dance club and a chance to drive a cold-war military tank. Next, they fly to Siberia and meet a vodka-slamming shaman, who puts them all to shame on the dance floor.

programme.desc: The guys head northeast into Siberia to reach the coldest inhabited place on earth: the Pole of Cold. Along the way, the word of Scott and Justin’s journey travels and they become local news celebrities. They visit a permanent circus, take part in the Festival of Cold, answer questions at local press conferences and end up judging a quirky beauty contest in Yakutsk. Riding reindeer for the rest of the trek, they camp in the snow before hitting the Pole of Cold.

They get to Sri Lanka’s capital city, Colombo, just in time to see the Navam Perahera – a spectacular parade made up of thousands of dancers and acrobats, and over a hundred decorated elephants.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Hanging On To Love
programme.desc: Serial dater, Jewel, cannot seem to find love, until she starts to fall for the owner of her dry cleaners.

programme.title: Smoke Break
programme.desc: Trell Bell, a sharp-tongued barber balances cutting fades and dodging drama from his baby momma. When the barber shopped is suddenly robbed, and the money all gone, Trell and his crew work together to save the barber shop.

programme.title: Bottle Girl
programme.desc: Diamond's dream of going to college is threatened by financial hardship. A desperate job at a glamorous Atlanta lounge exposes her to a world of temptation and danger. Can she navigate the high-stakes world of money, drugs, and sex, or will it consume her?

programme.title: Swept
programme.desc: Five old friends receive invitations to their 20 — year high school reunion, hoping to connect and reminisce. Little do they know, they've all been keeping a secret about events that unfolded over twenty years ago. Will secrets stay buried? Or with the weight of their guilt finally tear them apart?

programme.title: Under the Gun
programme.desc: Cam is a troubled street hustler battling addiction, grief, and mounting debt, as his recklessness threatens to dismantle the tight-knit crime family that raised him. When his brother and trusted runner, Jalen, is caught stealing, his punishment sets off a chain reaction of fear, suspicion, and violence.

programme.title: A Secret Lie in Love
programme.desc: Clarice and Chase Scott have the perfect suburban life on the outside. However, their marriage that was built on passion, has become a battlefield of deceit, infidelity, and betrayal. Clarice finds solace in the arms of another man, while Chase’s greed seems to unravel everything they’ve built. Will their marriage survive?

programme.title: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Sydney Carter is a restless college student that has always felt out of place. When she discovers she’s adopted, her world beings to unravel, and she embarks on a journey to discover her origins, but they come at a cost, and could destroy everything she’s ever known.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: We in This Together
programme.desc: Attorney August marries Daisha, a social climber more interested in his bank account than motherhood. To hide her infertility, Daisha secretly adopts 17-year-old "Lil August," sparking an immediate, violent rivalry. While August dismisses the teen’s lethal behavior as "playful," Daisha finds herself trapped in a house with a son who may be a killer. As she plots to conceive a biological heir, a series of dark secrets and "accidents" leave the family’s survival in question.

programme.title: ToxiCity
programme.desc: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order. A night out leads him to Sierra, an alluring actress who quickly moves in. Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: Transcend
programme.desc: Maranda spent her life looking for a protector, only to find herself lost in a cycle of toxic love and betrayal. From the wreckage of abandonment to a life-altering crossroads, her survival isn't just about escaping the past, it’s about surviving herself.

programme.title: Love Kills
programme.desc: In the heart of Atlanta's unpredictable dating scene, Darron is a hopeless romantic with the worst luck imaginable. Every time he believes he's found "the one," he ends up caught in another tangled web of passion, betrayal, and danger. When Darron finally meets someone who seems genuine, his past mistakes come back with a vengeance. One of his exes' jealous boyfriends discovers their hidden affair, setting off a chain of events that spirals out of control.

programme.title: Cuffin Season
programme.desc: Nate is a part-time Uber drive and a music video director, and is becoming a rising star in the music and video world. Everything is going great, except for the fact that he doesn’t have citizenship. He knows the easiest way for him to get citizenship is to get married, but he won’t settle for just any woman. Will he run out of time before immigration is onto him?

programme.title: 4x4
programme.sub-title: Classe empresarial com tracao nas quatro rodas
programme.desc: O Jaguar XF-S deve pressionar a BMW, a Audi e os outros concorrentes no segmento de classe executiva. Os britânicos querem ensinar aos melhores cães alemães o verdadeiro significado da palavra medo. A Volvo tem uma abordagem diferente. Seu S90 é cativante devido a seu design escandinavo e motores econômicos de quatro cilindros.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Como as vendas de SUV estão em alta há anos, os fabricantes também introduziram modelos compactos para grupos-alvo adicionais. A BMW oferece o X2 como um hipster para os jovens. O DS 7 Crossback, por outro lado, quer transmitir o estilo de vida francês. E a Jaguar's E-Pace entra no mercado como uma versão menor da F-Pace.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Como o Range Rover tem tido tanto sucesso ao longo dos anos, o fabricante britânico quer alcançar um público maior introduzindo um pequeno "Rangy": o Velar. Ao mesmo tempo, o jipe conta com o já testado: o projeto do Wrangler permaneceu quase o mesmo por mais de 60 anos. Além disso: o Volvo XC60 e o Ford Edge.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Com mais de 3,5 milhões de unidades vendidas no mundo todo, o Mercedes Sprinter ainda é um dos veículos comerciais mais populares. Para sua terceira geração, a marca optou por tê-lo fabricado na Polônia. Antes, esta van icônica dividia sua linha de produção com a concorrência da Volkswagen, a Crafter.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: A Porsche abandona o negócio de diesel. Espera-se que híbridos como o Cayenne E-Hybrid se tornem o foco de atenção para a marca. Também: levar a BMW X4 em turnê por Spartanburg, EUA, o local de nascimento deste coupé SUV. E: escalada de montanha com o Volkswagen Touareg na Áustria.

programme.title: Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10
programme.desc: O curso de gelo em Lungauring, o Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10 em treinamento de inverno. Doze participantes foram ensinados a arte de andar à deriva com um carro com tração nas quatro rodas. Acompanhamos um aluno em sua primeira experiência de drifting.

programme.title: O ZIS 110 de Josef Stalin
programme.desc: James Bond ainda não tinha uma licença para matar, quando este veículo russo representativo chamado ZIS 110 saiu da linha de produção em 1949. O 110 foi desenvolvido por engenharia reversa um Packard Super Eight de 1942.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Ao ganhar o icônico Rally Dakar 13 vezes, o francês Stephane Peterhansel teve uma carreira bastante incomum quando mudou de motocicletas para carros e desfrutou de enorme sucesso com ambos os veículos.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Alois Ruf é o fundador de uma pequena, mas conhecida empresa fabricante de carros na Baviera, especializada em construir sua própria visão de carros super esportivos legais de rua sobre a fundação de carrocerias Porsche.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Dos anos 50 aos 70, Hans Herrmann ganhou fama como piloto de Fórmula 1 e de carros esportivos para fabricantes como Porsche, Mercedes-Benz e Maserati, que também ganhou as 24 Horas de Le Mans várias vezes.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: As pessoas a chamavam de "Rainha da Nordschleife". Sabine Schmitz foi uma piloto de corridas de sucesso antes de trabalhar como apresentadora para a televisão alemã e mais tarde para o famoso programa da BBC "Top Gear".

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Oriundo de uma famosa família nobre, o Príncipe Leopold começou uma carreira como piloto de rally nos anos 60 antes de mudar para carros de turismo. Ele participou com sucesso de várias corridas internacionais, tais como as 24 Horas de Le Mans.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Seu nome é conhecido em todo o mundo. No início do século 20, o pioneiro automotivo Henry Ford revolucionou o mundo da fabricação de automóveis com a fundação da Ford Motor Company e sua introdução da linha de montagem.

programme.title: Ken Block no Monza Rallye Show
programme.desc: Em Monza, Ken Block está pronto para competir contra todas as estrelas do automobilismo no Monza Rally Show.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Nos anos 70, os modelos W 114/115 da Mercedes ofereciam engenharia sólida a preços moderados, o que fez com que o sedan com estilo Paul Braq se tornasse o primeiro Mercedes para pessoas comuns. Também: um inconspícuo Volkswagen Beetle de 1972 com 90 cv que atingiu 180 km/h na Autobahn. E: um marco na história automotiva da época: o NSU RO 80 com um motor rotativo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Nos anos 50, o Tatra da Tchecoslováquia introduziu carros avançados, até mesmo pioneiros. A clientela era exclusiva, e é por isso que estes carros são muito raros hoje em dia. Encontramos o proprietário de um Tatra T87 de 1937.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O Porsche 911 Targa, com sua construção leve, é um carro icônico. Além disso: o Lotus Seven Twin Cam SS é mais um carro de corrida do que um carro de estrada. E: o Bentley Blower de 1930 e o Sunbeam Tiger Roadster.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O GTA da Ford Fairlane de 1967 na forma NASCAR. Além disso: O Chrysler 300 C de 1995 era o veículo de produção mais potente dos Estados Unidos. E: o Cadillac série 62 conversível de 1949 estabelece novos padrões em luxo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O Triumph 1800 Roadster de 1947 oferece espaço para 5 entusiastas do ar fresco. Mais: The Jog, o rally de carros clássico mais difícil da Europa. E: o Wolseley Stellite de 1919.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: No final dos anos 50, a Facel Vega Facellia foi projetada para competir com a Porsche e a Alfa Romeo e abrir um novo segmento de mercado para a jovem empresa francesa de carros de luxo.

programme.title: BMW M3 Test Drive - A BMW de maior sucesso de todos os tempos!
programme.desc: Nos anos 80, a BMW lançou um carro que tinha verdadeiros genes de corrida, o M3. Originalmente concebido como modelo de homologação para o Campeonato Alemão de Carros de Turismo, tornou-se num dos carros desportivos de estrada mais quentes do mundo.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Os novos descapotáveis e a luz do sol pertencem apenas um ao outro. Nós testamos os novos descapotáveis da série 6 da BMW na Table Mountain, na África do Sul.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: A Audi construiu 333 unidades de seu modelo GT, e a mudança de marcha do carro mostra três zeros. O motorista de testes Patrick tentará descobrir do que se trata e ver o que 560 HP podem fazer na condução diária.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Hoje se trata de um peso leve no segmento de classe alta alemã, o Audi A6 2.0 TDI. Mais eficiência, menos peso e mais esportividade é o que o fabricante promove para vencer a corrida contra a BMW e a Mercedes.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Colocamos à prova os 555 HP do Wiesmann MF5 no hipódromo de Spa-Francochamps, nas Ardenas Belgas. Um projeto excepcional de carro esportivo, 8 cilindros, motor bi-turbo. Ele pode competir com Ferrari ou Porsche?

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: A corrida de 24 horas no Nürburgring é considerada a corrida de longa distância mais difícil nos esportes motorizados. A Volkswagen colocou a si mesma este desafio com um carro realmente especial.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: O Mercedes SL65 AMG é o último modelo alemão de carro de força em um terno feito sob medida.

programme.title: Jaguar D-Type
programme.desc: O grande vencedor nas 24 horas de Le Mans. O Jaguar D-Type ganhou a prova de enduro mais dura do mundo três vezes seguidas.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Um dos carros de corrida mais espetaculares do mundo: o Indy 500. Visto por um grande número de pessoas, ele nunca deixa de impressionar no circuito de corrida de Indianápolis.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: O campeonato alemão de rali é uma das séries mais populares do automobilismo, que vem correndo desde 1970. Em sua corrida de 1983, o modelo esportivo Opel foi excepcionalmente bem-sucedido.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Em 1985, a Audi precisou deixar sua marca no automobilismo e fez exatamente isso com o "Quattro". No cenário do rally, os caras de Ingolstadt (Alemanha) inventaram algo que é verdadeiramente de uma nova dimensão.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: 1954. A Mercedes corre novamente. Depois de mais de 20 anos de abstinência, a Mercedes retorna no circuito Grand-Prix. Com muito empenho, engenharia avançada e com os melhores pilotos de Grand-Prix do mundo.

programme.title: Histórico 'Fórmula V
programme.desc: No final da década de 1950, apareceram na América carros de corrida de Fórmula Vee. No final dos anos 70, a série foi descontinuada. Mas hoje os pequenos runabouts estão novamente em corrida na "Fórmula Vau Europa Histórica".

programme.title: Ken Block no Monza Rallye Show
programme.desc: Em Monza, Ken Block está pronto para competir contra todas as estrelas do automobilismo no Monza Rally Show.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: O fã Porsche Marco Wendlandt realiza seu sonho: dirigir um coupé Porsche 911 de 1984. Com a ajuda do grande Mike, um vendedor de carros de Los Angeles, ele encontra seu carro dos sonhos em São Francisco. Depois de visitar DenBeste e a coleção Mustang, eles se dirigem à fábrica de carros da Carol Shelby para completar o sonho americano dos motores V8.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Porsche Outlaw Magnus Walker, Los Angeles
programme.desc: Marco faz uma incrível viagem de carro pela Califórnia. Em seu recém-adquirido cupê Porsche 911 de 84, ele se dirige a Los Angeles para conhecer um dos mais conhecidos entusiastas da Porsche do mundo: Magnus Walker, o "fora-da-lei urbano". Depois de uma corrida improvisada pelas ruas da cidade, Magnus convida Marco a visitar sua oficina e sua impressionante coleção.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Contos de carros do Alto Deserto na California
programme.desc: Em sua viagem a Las Vegas, Marco visita o grande Mike em Apple Valley, uma área remota no alto deserto da Califórnia, onde eles encontram alguns amigos curiosos que já foram criadores de tendências na personalização do carro californiano. Ele então se envolve com os temíveis amigos motoqueiros do Big Mike enquanto eles circulam pelo deserto espalhando medo e pânico.

programme.title: BMW 503 - A Convertible with a V8 Engine
programme.desc: O nobre 4-lugares 503 conversível era um dos modelos mais exclusivos da BMW nos anos 50. Muitas estrelas internacionais do esporte e do cinema e outros clientes ricos gostavam deste veículo esportivo de luxo.

programme.title: BMW M3 Test Drive - A BMW de maior sucesso de todos os tempos!
programme.desc: Nos anos 80, a BMW lançou um carro que tinha verdadeiros genes de corrida, o M3. Originalmente concebido como modelo de homologação para o Campeonato Alemão de Carros de Turismo, tornou-se num dos carros desportivos de estrada mais quentes do mundo.

programme.title: Ford GT40 - Project 'Victory in Le Mans'
programme.desc: Com seus carros V8, a Ford mostrou que eles foram capazes de construir vencedores de corrida. O Ford GT40 foi um excelente exemplo para isso, especialmente em Le Mans.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Um touro furioso, alguns ingleses que se prepararam para condições climáticas bastante desagradáveis e um jovem e talentoso piloto de corrida, todos estes foram visitantes que se aventuraram ao infame Inferno Verde de Nürburgring.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Um Golf 2 afinado, um sedan familiar de Hannover, Alemanha e um Porsche GT2 muito especial. Olhamos para os bastidores do posto de gasolina pela curva da pista de corrida, onde os carros esportivos se aglomeram.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Quando o Nürburgring se transforma em um país maravilhoso de inverno, pode parecer agradável, mas com certeza não é muito agradável como pista de corrida.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Nevoeiro, chuva e neve significam que uma visita à região do Eifel não é muito agradável. Entretanto, os pilotos mais duros estavam na pista, não deixando o tempo atrapalhar o seu caminho.

programme.title: Jaguar XJR
programme.desc: O destaque do XJR está sob o capô: todos os modelos superiores da Jaguar são equipados com o motor compressor V8 de 5 litros que fornece 550 cavalos de potência neste sedan esportivo.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.sub-title: Chevrolet Camaro e Mercedes SLS AMG

programme.desc: Juan Diego le pregunta a Yubiri si quiere ir al cumpleaños de Cowalscky. Ella le dice que tiene un compromiso. El le anota la dirección y le dice que si pueda que vaya. Solymar llega a la plaza y los muchachos están un poco desanimados porque no ha llegado gente. Wilker le pregunta por Yubiri y ella le dice que ya debe estar por llegar. La cena de Armando | Briggite | Atanasio y Gisela están en punto efervescente. Briggite y Gisela se tiran bombas y bombas.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 200: Embarazo Desconsolado y Deseos de Renuncia

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 145: Bodas, un Nuevo Inicio y Despedidas
programme.desc: Walter llega a la casa de Felix y Luis Guillermo para anunciarles que Betania decidió divorciarse rápidamente y para decirles que Inés se está marchando a Nueva York para siempre. Alfredo está feliz porque ve a su hija en el retén y Diego Andrés llega para felicitarlo y pedirle que le conceda el divorcio a Marisela. Inés llega al aeropuerto y se entera que quien se va en su lugar es Betania y le deja el camino libre con Luis Guillermo quien llega a buscarlo y unos meses después, se preparan las bodas de Marisela y Diego Andrés y de Luis Guillermo con Inés y Daniela se queda a vivir en Miami, donde vive a cuerpo de reina como ella siempre quiso y le cuenta a su hermana que no piensa regresar nunca más a Venezuela.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Junior corteja a Rosa rumbo a la residencia, pero ella lo rechaza recordando la muerte de su hermano. Maricela ataca a Adolfo en plena ebriedad delante de Andreína y Rosalía. Rosa, ilusionada con Alejandro, lo ve partir sin saber que él fue a un compromiso forzado. Consuelo discute con Rosa creéndola ladrona, sin sospechar que es su hija perdida; luego se arrepiente. Eustoquio, instigado por Erasto, revela a Isaías que Consuelo tuvo una hija con Adolfo, sembrando el odio que destruirá a la familia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Luego de la pelea en el baño con Alejandra, Irene decide regresar a su casa sin decirle a Leonardo. Ahí, su hermana Lucía le confiesa que Rodrigo Basáñez la ha estado amenazando. Agustina recibe una extraña llamada telefónica de alguien que decía ser su difunta hermana, lo cual la angustia muchísimo, ya que ese día iba a preparar una cena especial en honor a ella. Maribel le pide a Tony que revisen las cámaras de seguridad para comprobar la inocencia de Irene, pero a él se le ocurre una mejor idea para desenmascarar a Alejandra.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Luego de que Ana muriera, Sol comienza a temer aún más por su vida. El comisario Tavares considera el asesinato como una sospecha más en contra de la familia Monserrat y Alejandro sigue negando la posibilidad de que su madre esté detrás de todo eso. Eloy está dispuesto a aclarar la situación entre él y Columba. No quiere andar escondiéndose. Al encontrarse con José Domingo, Eloy le dice que piensa hacer de Columba su esposa. José Domingo va donde Columba y le dice que no tiene ninguna objeción.

Inés llega al aeropuerto y se entera que quien se va en su lugar es Betania y le deja el camino libre con Luis Guillermo quien llega a buscarlo y unos meses después, se preparan las bodas de Marisela y Diego Andrés y de Luis Guillermo con Inés y Daniela se queda a vivir en Miami, donde vive a cuerpo de reina como ella siempre quiso y le cuenta a su hermana que no piensa regresar nunca más a Venezuela.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Junior corteja a Rosa rumbo a la residencia, pero ella lo rechaza recordando la muerte de su hermano. Maricela ataca a Adolfo en plena ebriedad delante de Andreína y Rosalía. Rosa, ilusionada con Alejandro, lo ve partir sin saber que él fue a un compromiso forzado. Consuelo discute con Rosa creéndola ladrona, sin sospechar que es su hija perdida; luego se arrepiente. Eustoquio, instigado por Erasto, revela a Isaías que Consuelo tuvo una hija con Adolfo, sembrando el odio que destruirá a la familia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Luego de la pelea en el baño con Alejandra, Irene decide regresar a su casa sin decirle a Leonardo. Ahí, su hermana Lucía le confiesa que Rodrigo Basáñez la ha estado amenazando. Agustina recibe una extraña llamada telefónica de alguien que decía ser su difunta hermana, lo cual la angustia muchísimo, ya que ese día iba a preparar una cena especial en honor a ella. Maribel le pide a Tony que revisen las cámaras de seguridad para comprobar la inocencia de Irene, pero a él se le ocurre una mejor idea para desenmascarar a Alejandra.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Luego de que Ana muriera, Sol comienza a temer aún más por su vida. El comisario Tavares considera el asesinato como una sospecha más en contra de la familia Monserrat y Alejandro sigue negando la posibilidad de que su madre esté detrás de todo eso. Eloy está dispuesto a aclarar la situación entre él y Columba. No quiere andar escondiéndose. Al encontrarse con José Domingo, Eloy le dice que piensa hacer de Columba su esposa. José Domingo va donde Columba y le dice que no tiene ninguna objeción.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Juan Diego le pregunta a Yubiri si quiere ir al cumpleaños de Cowalscky. Ella le dice que tiene un compromiso. El le anota la dirección y le dice que si pueda que vaya. Solymar llega a la plaza y los muchachos están un poco desanimados porque no ha llegado gente. Wilker le pregunta por Yubiri y ella le dice que ya debe estar por llegar. La cena de Armando | Briggite | Atanasio y Gisela están en punto efervescente. Briggite y Gisela se tiran bombas y bombas.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 200: Embarazo Desconsolado y Deseos de Renuncia
programme.desc: Cristina está desconsolada al saber que está embarazada de Gerson porque no tiene ninguna esperanza de buena vida y la Miss intenta consolarla. Por otro lado, Matilde y Moncho quieren renunciar y Marco Aurelio está muy sorprendido por la decisión de ambos

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene insiste en que Leonardo debe creer en su inocencia sin necesidad de pruebas. Él va a casa de su madre a buscarla, pero, tras una charla larga, ella decide tomarse un tiempo para que ambos reflexionen. Leonardo no está presente la noche de la ceremonia en memoria de Rebeca, porque fue con Anzola a buscar a Irene. Agustina se enfurece y promete revelar un secreto terrible a la familia. Camacho, quien trabaja bajo las órdenes de Rodrigo, planea entrar al departamento de las Gutiérrez y llevarse los documentos por la fuerza. Pero la llegada de Leonardo se lo impide. Sandra le pide a María Lucía que le cuente todo sobre el chico que conoció en la universidad.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro va en busca de Sol para sacarla de la cárcel y así cuidarla a ella y al bebé. Luego de una larga charla, Sol le confiesa a Alejandro que el hijo que está esperando es suyo. Maricielo sigue con el corazón roto, y Alicia decide prepararle una cita con Víctor Hugo. Eloy Arturo presenta los papeles del divorcio y habla con Reina para comunicárselo. Reina le advierte que, dentro de algunos meses, él tendrá que cambiar de idea. Giselle quiere quedar embarazada de Cristo José.

programme.title: Siga seu coração

programme.title: Entre o Amor e a Fama
programme.desc: Uma estrela de reality show deixa Hollywood e se reencontra em uma comunidade Amish, em Nebraska, onde deve decidir entre permanecer em sua nova realidade ou retornar à antiga.

programme.title: Plus One at an Amish Wedding
programme.desc: A médica em ascensão April tem a vida perfeita. Ela trabalha em um hospital prestigiado em Nova York e acabou de conhecer um veterinário bonito chamado Jesse. programme.title: Suite Francesa
programme.desc: França, 1940. Enquanto espera por notícias do marido, um prisioneiro de guerra, a bela Lucile leva uma vida reprimida com sua sogra controladora. No inicio, Lucile tenta ignorar Bruno, o refinado oficial alemão que estava com elas, mas depois, um amor forte atrai-los e leva-os a tragédia da guerra.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Sonic TV
programme.desc: The Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog 24/7

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 3 - Finland Teams World
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 6 - World's Strongest Latino
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 7 - Finland World Record Breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Tasting Switzerland's Mountain Culture | Alpine Cheese, Snowboarding & Foraging"
programme.desc: In Switzerland, everything you need is right in the backyard. That might be tough to believe while taking in the staggering peaks and powdery snow, but the DIRT crew learned it firsthand on their latest adventure. The key? The warmth and resourcefulness of the Swiss people. Josh and co got the lay of the land from chef Sarah Lämmli, foraging wild ramps, moss, and dried leaves on the outskirts of Lucerne. Then they worked their way up, carving lines into Interlaken’s ski slopes and learning how the locals thrive (and even make speakeasies out of ice) in the abundant mountain landscape.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: For many protected reserves across Africa, the elephant populations are expanding, and this comes with a critical problem: what happens to the elephants when an area reaches carrying capacity? Dan Cabela investigates the growing problem, visiting Zimbabwe, Namibia and Angola to explore the future of elephant conservation.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff scour the rugged mountains of southern Arizona in search of the elusive Coues deer, known to hunters as the “Grey Ghost.” Through scorching sun and shifting winds, they test their skill and patience chasing one of North America’s most elusive big game animals.

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.sub-title: "Glenn Arbor with Reel Tales Fishing Charter"
programme.desc: Danny discovers two northern Michigan watering holes and fishing with a local guide, Reel Tales Fishing Charters.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.sub-title: "Alaska's Massive Marvels: A Boating Expedition through America's Last Frontier Pt 1"
programme.desc: From battling towering 12-foot waves in the Gulf of Alaska, to reeling in colossal 200 lb. halibut, they discover firsthand the rugged beauty of America's 49th state. This episode highlights Lindell Yachts as a top builder of rugged offshore sportfishing yachts, as well as Radon Boats as great pilothouse fishing and guide boats.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael and Larken travel to South Carolina's Lowcountry for a massive barbecue charity event supporting children battling serious illness. After serving up smoke for a great cause, they spend an extra day in the marsh chasing redfish and speckled trout.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: On this episode of Goin' Coastal, Capt. Josh Calhoon brings his store manager Isaiah Lopez with him on a day of inshore fishing for trout and redfish.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.sub-title: "Are Dinosaurs Still Alive In The African Congo?"
programme.desc: Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what’s really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Captain Josh takes Don from LBP inshore fishing for species he's never caught before, with one unforgettable battle stealing the show.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Despite the weather, Capt. Josh Calhoon and his wife Anna take a day off to target mangrove snapper before moving into deeper water to search for quality amberjacks.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: In this episode of Goin' Coastal, Captain Josh and Anna Calhoon set out for some fun Flounder fishing. They enjoy a delicious hook & cook served up fresh from their day at AJ's!

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: With rods bent and fish in the box, Capt. Josh and Alex Fogg reel in a variety of species to assist with important research on fish growth and population health.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: The Green Way team continue their African journey with hunts for both the majestic Kudu and elusive Golden Wildebeest. The experience comes full circle when the meat from these animals is donated to local schoolchildren, who receive not only fresh meals but also school supplies and sweets that light up the village.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff join a local biologist searching for a white rhino whose tracking collar has failed, leaving it exposed to poachers. As they follow its trail through the African bush, the search builds toward a heart-pounding encounter that none of them will ever forget.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle takes to the water in a way few anglers dare, fishing from a Sea-Doo in search of the ancient lake sturgeon, a species that’s been around since the age of the dinosaurs and can live over 100 years. Hooking into one of North America’s largest freshwater fish from a personal watercraft proves to be a challenge unlike any other.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the legendary Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves. Amidst echoes of calling and wingbeats, they experience one of America’s most iconic duck hunts.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: As an avid bird hunter who grew up sharing his passion with his dad, Mark Peterson has traveled the globe pursuing his favorite game. After completing the North America Upland Slam and the New Zealand Wingshooting Slam both in a single season, he’s setting his sights on the South America Upland Slam.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: On day three of Mark Peterson’s South America Upland Slam adventure, the guys are snowed in while waiting to head to La Pampa, where the weather promised to be much better. After a tense wait for the go-ahead to fly out, they finally touched down in La Pampa and headed straight to the field. There, the grasslands and scattered thickets provide the perfect habitat for Bushed Tinamou, known for their elusive nature and penchant for hiding among dense underbrush. Day four is dedicated to hunting these Tinamou, with Mark eager to track them in their natural habitat. On day five, their focus shifts to Pigeons, where they set up decoys along the edge of a cut cornfield. The anticipation of drawing in flocks makes for an incredible hunt and Mark can’t wait to see what the day will bring.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: In this episode, Mark Peterson finds himself deep in the heart of Peru and focuses on completing the prestigious South America Upland Slam. With only one bird remaining, the Western Peruvian Dove, the trip has led him to a private hunting property. This final challenge will take place over a cut cornfield, a favorite spot for the doves. To blend in, Mark and his team craft a makeshift blind using a mix of corn stalks, and timber, just enough cover while allowing for a clear shot. These West Peruvian Doves are known for their erratic flight patterns, often bouncing from one tree to another in a random manner, making timing and placement critical.

programme.title: The Bearded Buck
programme.desc: Jerry and Austin are back in the Cornhusker state again! But this time, they're going there for antelope! This is Austin's first time ever attempting to hunt these elusive animals and patience is the name of the game.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode, we travel to Walker, Minnesota to highlight a great organization tucked back in the woods called Camp Bliss! Camp Bliss hosts a wide arrange of events throughout the year that are tailored for Veterans to find rest, relaxation and respite. We tag along on an Ice Fishing outing, a turkey hunt and a Women's Veterans retreat as we highlight this great organization and the heroes they serve. We also highlight Des Moine Iowa SCHEELS hometown hero, Navy Veteran Steve Booth!

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode, we travel to Parker, South Dakota for a European pheasant hunt at Wings of Valor Lodge! The South Dakota DAV chapter is onsite for a great day of hunting and fellowship. We also honor Missoula Scheels Hometown Hero, Anton Johnson!

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: WWII U.S. Navy veteran Bill Kruschel recounts a journey from humble beginnings in the midst of the Great Depression to his valuable service in the Navy, culminating in a lifelong commitment to the field of special education.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: An Honor No One Wants: A Gold Star Family is the immediate family member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. Kelli Campbell Goodnow honors the memory her husband…American hero Shawn Campbell.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Youth turkey season in Alabama is always special, but this one means a little bit more. Isaac takes Dylan Hunt to the woods for Alabama’s Youth Opening Weekend with hopes of calling in Dylan a gobbler. Youth season is all about passing on the tradition, and there’s nothing better than watching the next generation experience the thrill of turkey hunting.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: The Alabama turkey opener is a tradition we look forward to every single year. This season, Aaron and Nick from The Hunting Public joined us in camp to kick things off and experience the opener with us. Good friends, strong tradition, and some Alabama gobblers made for an unforgettable start to the season.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: It's the second day of the Alabama Turkey season, and we hit the woods with Dr. Mike Chamberlain and Aaron Warbritton from The Hunting Public in search of a longbeard. Watching turkeys just being turkeys, and spending time with great friends is why turkey hunting is just different to us.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Two of the best in the game, get to experience one unforgettable Nebraska hunt. Billy Yargus and Phillip Vanderpool are at Hidden Valley Outfitters in Arnold, Nebraska for a turkey hunt that turned into one they will never forget. Patience, experience, and elite calling paid off when these longbeards finally committed, and came all the way to 20 steps.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: On a crisp Iowa November morning, everything comes together as Drake Lamb with Midwest Whitetail grunts in a massive 8-point buck that he encountered before with the WoodHaven Midwest Grunter. This is one hunt you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Mark Scroggins and his family are in Oklahoma and spot a big gobbler from the road. They are pretty sure they can get in position to call him in but they have to be quick without being seen. His step-daughter Destiny is behind the trigger and Mark just about puts this ol gobbler in her lap!

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

This week, we trail Adam Hays and Kris Seymour into the wilds of New Mexico, where they pursue giant bull elk. Adam embarks on a DIY hunt on a new ranch while Kris, perched high in his Lone Wolf tree stand, sets his sights on a massive bull at his favorite watering hole.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Ismael Garcia was just a young soldier when a tragic incident in Afghanistan changed his life forever. He was left wounded and scarred, but the hardest part came after he returned home. Hunting had always been his escape. But after war, everything felt different — until he picked up a bow.

programme.title: Pure Hunting

They are hoping for a little luck with the gobblers, and they know they are going to have a good time trying.

programme.title: Pure Hunting

Not only Nessi, but the Scottish high lands are the miracle of nature.Then we quickly visit Andalusia and remove our hat in front of the majestic mountains of Sierra Nevada.The deepest lake in the world is found in Siberia. We will talk about Baikal, the natural miracle of Russia.
